review_status: PENDING — distilled from sources/02 and sources/03 by the implementer. Not yet reviewed by Alexandra. Every rendered draft states this until she signs off.

_schema_notes.verbatim: MUST be an exact substring of the referenced source file. plan_rules_check.py asserts this. It is printed next to any model claim citing the rule, so Alexandra always reviews against her own sentence rather than a paraphrase.
_schema_notes.referral_kind: refer_out = send the patient elsewhere instead of (or alongside) treating. test_first = do not start this specific intervention until the named labs exist; not a referral of the whole case.
_schema_notes.action: avoid = never in this context. limit = dose ceiling. caution = permitted with monitoring. separate = timing conflict only. test_first = requires labs before use. lab_interference = distorts a test result.
